name: Lore
description: Build your deck's world: its characters, places, groups, items and events, what each is, and the cards about each. Gathers them from your cards (legendary cards, who speaks in flavour text), finds a series' characters online, looks up their stories, and makes cards for them with abilities that fit. Kept with the deck as lore.json; saves as a text file.
author: MEZTKING
